query:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store.holds h
                              JOIN store.objects o ON o.pool = h.pool AND o.sha256 = h.sha256
                              WHERE h.pool = $1 AND h.sha256 = $2 AND h.holder_kind = 'root'
                                AND h.holder_id = $3 AND o.state = 'present') AS "held!"
